title: HuDiff humanizes antibodies and nanobodies while retaining measured binding
summary: HuDiff generated humanized variants of a murine SARS-CoV-2 RBD antibody and two alpaca nanobodies. Bio-layer interferometry measured 0.15 nM affinity for the best humanized antibody versus 0.12 nM for its parent; a humanized nanobody measured 2.52 nM versus 5.47 nM. The journal abstract also reports viral neutralization. The October 2025 journal date follows an October 25, 2024 precursor describing one antibody and one nanobody.
organization: School of Basic Medical Sciences, Lanzhou University; Tencent AI Lab; Fudan University; Peking University

evidence.tested: Newly humanized molecules underwent binding assays; journal abstract reports neutralization.
evidence.unknown: Main journal methods are subscription content and were not assessed. Humanness scores do not establish reduced human immunogenicity or clinical safety.
evidence.ai_role: Adaptive autoregressive diffusion generates humanized framework sequences from CDR inputs.
